property_summary: After any successful call to owned(), the owner must be the previous owner (non-zero) because onlyOwner ensures msg.sender == owner; the mutant sets owner to address(0), so a subsequent call by the original owner fails the onlyOwner check on burn, causing a revert.
change_summary: Replace `owner = payable(msg.sender)` with `owner = payable(address(0))` so owned() sets owner to zero address.
